item.title: Greenlight Networks: $24 Million Investment To Expand Fiber Internet Across Northeast Pennsylvania
item.description: Greenlight Networks announced a $24 million investment to accelerate the expansion of its fiber internet infrastructure across Northeast Pennsylvania, extending high speed connectivity to more than 15,500 additional households in the Scranton and Wilkes-Barre regions. item.description: Propy, an AI-driven real estate transactions platform, announced the acquisition of the title division of Florida-based Boss Law as part of its $100 million national roll-up strategy to modernize title and escrow services with artificial intelligence and blockchain infrastructure. item.title: NGL Energy Partners: $950 Million Term Loan To Redeem Preferred Units And Restructure Debt
item.description: NGL Energy Partners LP announced that it has closed a new seven-year $950 million senior secured term loan facility through its subsidiaries NGL Energy Operating LLC and NGL Energy Finance Corp. The financing is part of a broader effort to simplify the company’s capital structure and repurchase a portion of its preferred equity.
